description: i19 Stormwater Resource Plans Polys is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Water Resources. The feature dataset contains data representing storm water projects planned in the future throughout regions in California that involve groundwater recharge and direct use. It was used to develop storm water targets for the years 2020 and 2035 per directives to DWR in California Water Code Section 10608.50 (b). Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Water Resources. Its tags are 2015, 2035, California, Communication, DWR. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
